set-page-background-image-from-stream.title: Set PDF Page Background Image from Stream
set-page-background-image-from-stream.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF, add a page, load an image from a file stream, assign it as the page background, and save the document using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add Background Image to PDF Page from Stream
add-background-image-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to add a new page to a PDF, set its background image using a file stream, and save the document.

add-background-image-to-pdf-page__v2.title: Add Background Image to PDF Page
add-background-image-to-pdf-page__v2.description: Demonstrates how to load an image stream, create a BackgroundArtifact, assign the image as a background, attach it to the first page, and save the PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-image-to-pdf-page__v3.title: Add Background Image to PDF Page
add-background-image-to-pdf-page__v3.description: Demonstrates creating a BackgroundArtifact, assigning an image stream as its background, attaching it to the second page of a PDF, and saving the document.

add-background-image-to-pdf-page__v4.title: Add Background Image to PDF Page Using a Stream
add-background-image-to-pdf-page__v4.description: Demonstrates how to create a BackgroundArtifact, set its BackgroundImage from a file stream, attach it to the third page of a PDF, and save the modified document.

add-background-image-to-pdf-page__v5.title: Add Background Image to a PDF Page
add-background-image-to-pdf-page__v5.description: Shows how to load an image stream, configure a BackgroundArtifact, attach it to the fourth page of a PDF, and save the updated document.

add-background-image-to-pdf-page__v6.title: Add Background Image to PDF Page Using Stream
add-background-image-to-pdf-page__v6.description: Demonstrates creating a BackgroundArtifact, assigning an image stream as its BackgroundImage, attaching it to the fifth page of a PDF, and saving the document.

add-background-image-to-pdf-page__v7.title: Add Background Image to PDF Page
add-background-image-to-pdf-page__v7.description: Shows how to create a BackgroundArtifact, set its BackgroundImage from a memory stream, attach it to a specific page (page 6) of a PDF, and save the document with the background applied.

add-different-background-images-to-pdf-p.title: Add Different Background Images to PDF Pages
add-different-background-images-to-pdf-p.description: Shows how to load image streams, create BackgroundArtifact objects for each, assign them to separate PDF pages, and save the resulting document.

create-pdf-unique-background-per-page.title: Create PDF with Unique Background Image per Page
create-pdf-unique-background-per-page.description: Shows how to generate a PDF, add five pages, set a different background image on each page, and save the file using Aspose.Pdf.

set-different-background-images-for-pdf-.title: Set Different Background Images for PDF Pages
set-different-background-images-for-pdf-.description: Demonstrates how to add three pages to a PDF and assign a distinct background image to each page using image streams.

set-different-background-colors-for-pdf-.title: Set Different Background Colors for PDF Pages
set-different-background-colors-for-pdf-.description: Shows how to create a PDF document, add two pages, and assign distinct background colors to each page using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-background-image-to-first-three-pd.title: Apply Background Image to First Three PDF Pages
apply-background-image-to-first-three-pd.description: Demonstrates how to attach a background image to the first three pages of a PDF document and save the modified file using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-image-to-last-page.title: Add Background Image to Last Page of PDF
add-background-image-to-last-page.description: Demonstrates how to attach a background image to the final page of a six‑page PDF using Aspose.Pdf and save the modified document.

add-background-image-first-page-blank-pa.title: Add Background Image to First Page and Append Blank Page
add-background-image-first-page-blank-pa.description: Loads an existing PDF (or creates a new one), applies a background image to the first page using an ImageStamp, adds a blank page, and saves the modified document.

add-image-background-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Image Background to PDF Pages
add-image-background-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load an image into memory, create BackgroundArtifact objects, assign them as page backgrounds for multiple pages, and save the resulting PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-different-background-images-to-pdf-p.title: Add Different Background Images to PDF Pages
add-different-background-images-to-pdf-p.description: Shows how to load image files as BackgroundArtifact objects, assign each to a separate PDF page, and save the document.

add-different-background-images-to-pdf-p.title: Add Different Background Images to PDF Pages
add-different-background-images-to-pdf-p.description: Shows how to apply a background image to the first page and a different background image to the second page of an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-image-to-page-three.title: Add Background Image to Specific PDF Page
add-background-image-to-page-three.description: Shows how to place a background image on the third page of an existing PDF while keeping all other pages unchanged using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-image-to-pdf-page__v8.title: Add Background Image to PDF Page
add-background-image-to-pdf-page__v8.description: Demonstrates how to open an existing PDF, attach a background image to the third page using a BackgroundArtifact, and save the modified document.

set-page-background-image.title: Set Page Background Image in PDF
set-page-background-image.description: Demonstrates loading an image file and assigning it as the background image of a PDF page using Aspose.PDF, then saving the document.

add-background-image-to-first-pdf-page.title: Add Background Image to First PDF Page
add-background-image-to-first-pdf-page.description: Shows how to place a full‑page background image on the first page of a newly created PDF document using Aspose.Pdf and then save the file.

add-decorative-background-image-to-pdf-p.title: Add Decorative Background Image to PDF Page
add-decorative-background-image-to-pdf-p.description: Demonstrates how to place an image as a background on the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and then save the document.

add-background-image-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Background Image Watermark to PDF Pages
add-background-image-watermark-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to apply a background image as a watermark to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and save the modified document.

add-background-image-to-first-pdf-page__.title: Add Background Image to First PDF Page
add-background-image-to-first-pdf-page__.description: Demonstrates loading an image stream, creating a BackgroundArtifact, assigning it to the first page of a PDF, and saving the document with only that page having a background.

set-pdf-page-background-image-from-strea.title: Set PDF Page Background Image from Stream
set-pdf-page-background-image-from-strea.description: Shows how to open an image file as a stream, assign it to a page's BackgroundImage property, and keep the stream open until the PDF is saved.

set-page-background-image__v2.title: Set Page Background Image with BackgroundArtifact
set-page-background-image__v2.description: Demonstrates how to load an image stream, create a BackgroundArtifact, assign the image as a page background, and save the PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-page-background-image-from-stream__v.title: Set Page Background Image from Stream
set-page-background-image-from-stream__v.description: Shows how to create a PDF document, add a page, load an image from a file stream and assign it as the page's background, then save the PDF.

create-pdf-with-image-background.title: Create PDF with Image Background Using BackgroundArtifact
create-pdf-with-image-background.description: Shows how to load an image into a memory stream, create BackgroundArtifact objects, apply the same background to multiple PDF pages, and save the document.

add-same-background-image-to-multiple-pd.title: Add Same Background Image to Multiple PDF Pages
add-same-background-image-to-multiple-pd.description: Demonstrates creating a three‑page PDF and attaching the same background image to each page using a BackgroundArtifact.
